Package io.github.janglada.orkit

Interface CpSatSolver<S extends Solution>

All Superinterfaces:
Solver<S>
public interface CpSatSolver<S extends Solution> extends Solver<S>
Solver backed by CP-SAT. Adds the knobs CP-SAT honors on top of the shared interface: parallel workers, random seed, intermediate-solution callbacks, warm starts from a previous solution, and cancellation.

Every domain except routing returns this type from solver().

    • workers

      CpSatSolver<S> workers(int threads)
      Sets the number of parallel search workers; must be at least 1. Default: 8 (the portfolio size CP-SAT is tuned for), capped at the number of processors available to the JVM.

    • seed

      CpSatSolver<S> seed(int randomSeed)
      Sets the random seed. Runs are reproducible for the same seed only when workers(int) is 1; with several workers the interleaving of subsolvers is not deterministic.

    • onSolution

      CpSatSolver<S> onSolution(Consumer<S> listener)
      Registers a listener invoked for every improving intermediate solution found during the search. The listener receives a fully built result whose status is SolveStatus.FEASIBLE; it runs on the solver thread and should return quickly. An exception thrown by the listener stops the search and is rethrown from Solver.solve() wrapped in a ModelException; an Error is rethrown as is.

    • warmStart

      CpSatSolver<S> warmStart(S previous)
      Uses a previous feasible solution as search hints (warm start). Ids in the previous solution that no longer exist in the model are ignored, so a result can be reused after the model has been edited.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if previous is null or not feasible

    • exportModel

      CpSatSolver<S> exportModel(Path file)
      Writes the CP-SAT model to file just before each search, for inspection or for reproducing a solve outside this library. The file is text protobuf when its name ends in .txt or .textproto, binary protobuf otherwise. The model is validated first; Solver.solve() then throws ModelException if the model is invalid or the file cannot be written.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if file is null

    • explainInfeasibility

      CpSatSolver<S> explainInfeasibility(boolean explain)
      When the model turns out infeasible, solves it once more with its main constraint groups labeled (for example a shift's staffing, an operation's deadline, the pieces of one type) and reports the labels of a set of groups that cannot hold together in SolveDiagnostics.infeasibilityReasons(). The set is sufficient for infeasibility but not necessarily minimal, and constraints the library does not label (such as no-overlap) are always assumed. Off by default; costs one extra single-worker solve, and only on infeasible models.

    • cancel

      void cancel()
      Asks a running solve to stop as soon as possible; Solver.solve() then returns the best solution found so far. A solve is running from the moment Solver.solve() is entered, so a cancel issued while the model is still being built is honored too. Safe to call from another thread or from an onSolution(java.util.function.Consumer<S>) listener. A no-op when no solve is running.
